rendered.text: AlgoWars REFERRALS Join ALGOWARS REFERRAL NETWORK Refer vetted engineers. Earn your referral bonus. AlgoWars is the arena where engineers prove themselves in 1v1 algorithm battles. Refer one of our skill-verified candidates at your company — when they get hired, the referral bonus is yours. We handle the vetting; you just make the intro. Join the community Free to join · One WhatsApp community · No commitment Work at a company that pays a referral bonus? You're exactly who this is for. Turn a bonus you'd never otherwise claim into money — by referring someone who has already proven they can do the job. WHY REFER WITH US Earn your referral bonus Most companies pay a real bonus when someone you refer gets hired. Refer an AlgoWars-vetted candidate and that bonus is yours. We do the vetting Every candidate has proven their skill in live 1v1 algorithm battles and the career campaign. You only ever pass on people who can actually perform. Zero sourcing effort No sifting through resumes, no cold DMs. We match you with a candidate who fits an open role at your company. Your reputation stays safe Because every candidate is skill-verified before you see them, referring them protects your standing with your recruiting team instead of risking it. HOW IT WORKS 01 Join the community Hop into our WhatsApp community — that's the entire application. No forms. 02 Get matched Tell us your company and team. We match you with a pre-vetted AlgoWars candidate for a real opening there. 03 Drop the referral Submit them through your company's normal referral flow. We hand you everything you need. 04 Get paid When they're hired, you collect your company's referral bonus. That's it. Ready to earn? Join the WhatsApp community and we'll match you with your first candidate. Join the community ← Back to algowars.online·AlgoWars Referral Network
